title: Canadian PM Mark Carney, Cambodian Deputy PM Hang Choun Naron arrive in PH for ASEAN Summit
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister Dr. Hang Choun Naron arrived in Manila on Saturday morning to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit.

blocks.text: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister Dr. Hang Choun Naron arrivals, Nov. 14, 2026. Screengrabs from ASEAN Philippines 2026/YouTube and RTVM
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister Dr. Hang Choun Naron arrived in Manila on Saturday morning to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit.
Both leaders arrived at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport, according to a report by Mao dela Cruz on Super Radyo dzBB.

𝗗𝗨𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗡𝗔 𝗦𝗔 𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗦𝗔 Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister Dr. Hang Choun Naron, at Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, dumating na sa Pilipinas para dumalo sa 49th ASEAN Summit. | via Mao Dela Cruz https://t.co/myW8Ocz3YR Other Stories — DZBB Super Radyo (@dzbb) November 13, 2026
ASEAN leaders began arriving in the Philippines on November 14, the Department of Foreign Affairs earlier said.
The summit is scheduled from November 16 to 18, with the opening ceremony taking place on November 15.
The DFA earlier confirmed that global leaders, including US President Donald Trump, are set to attend the summit on November 17.
The Philippines is hosting this year's ASEAN Summit. —KG, GMA News
